'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**[[Pakistani Taliban]] [[insurgent]]s [[ambush]] a [[Pakistan Army|military]] convoy in [[South Waziristan]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], triggering a [[shootout]], with at least six soldiers and four [[militant]]s killed. [https://news.yahoo.com/pakistani-taliban-ambushed-military-convoy-095149939.html (AP via Yahoo! News)]

**The [[Mexican Army]] says that [[drug cartel]]s have increased usage of [[improvised explosive devices]], with 42 soldiers, police and suspects wounded this year. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-1581883d951c8f7a79ac5c61ec558b78 (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] [[shell (projectile)|shell]] [[Torske, Lyman urban hromada, Kramatorsk Raion, Donetsk Oblast|Torske]] and Zavitne in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], killing three people and injuring two others. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-66589595 (BBC News)]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[2023 Atlantic hurricane season#Tropical Storm Harold|Tropical Storm Harold]] makes landfall in south [[Texas]], [[United States]], the first during the hurricane season. A [[tropical storm]] warning is issued for parts of Texas and the [[Mexico–United States border|Mexican border]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/US/tropical-storm-harold-strengthens-gulf-mexico-approaches-texas/story?id=102442797 (ABC News)]
*[[2023 Greece wildfires]]
**Eighteen people are found dead amid [[wildfire]]s in the [[Dadia Forest]] in [[Greece]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-66579193 (BBC News)]
*Sixteen people are killed and thirty-six others are injured after a bus carrying Mexican and [[Venezuela]]n [[Immigration|migrants]] crashes into a [[freight truck]] in [[Oaxaca]], [[Mexico]]. [https://apnews.com/article/migrants-venezuela-mexico-bus-crash-15-dead-3282095bf5f43ac5f282b96109e4ed9c (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[15th BRICS summit]]
**The BRICS summit begins in [[Johannesburg]], [[South Africa]]. The summit will focus on the bloc's expansion and role among the economies of the [[Global South]]. [https://peoplesdispatch.org/2023/08/22/brics-summit-begins-with-focus-on-expansion-de-dollarization/ (Peoples Dispatch)]
*[[2023 Nigerien crisis]]
**The [[African Union]]'s [[Peace and Security Council]] votes to suspends [[Niger]]'s membership with immediate effect. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/8/22/african-union-suspends-niger-with-immediate-effect-for-july-26-coup (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Human rights in the United States]]
**The [[American Civil Liberties Union]] and three [[advocacy group]]s release a report examining the screening system at the [[Torrance County]] [[Immigration detention|Detention Facility]] where claims to [[Right of asylum|asylum]] were inappropriately screened out for [[deportation]]. Complaints of [[retaliation]] against [[Human migration|migrant]]s who objected to procedures and living conditions were cataloged. [https://apnews.com/article/migrant-advocates-criticize-detention-center-1c9b5c245e6fddeb8d99583988caacd3 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Cambodian general election]]
**[[Hun Manet]] is approved as the next [[Prime Minister of Cambodia|Prime Minister]] by the [[National Assembly (Cambodia)|National Assembly]]. [https://www.wionews.com/world/cambodian-lawmakers-elect-hun-sens-son-as-new-pm-627773 (AFP via WION)]
*[[2023 Thai general election]]
**[[Srettha Thavisin]] is approved as the next [[prime minister of Thailand|Prime Minister]] in a joint session of [[National Assembly (Thailand)|parliament]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/thailands-srettha-become-pm-after-securing-endorsement-parliament-2023-08-22/ (Reuters)]
**Former Prime Minister [[Thaksin Shinawatra]] returns to [[Thailand]] after 15 years of self-exile. He is arrested and jailed by the [[Supreme Court of Thailand]] over his existing [[conviction]]s. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-66577725 (BBC News)] [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/politics/2633718/thaksin-arrives-at-don-mueang-makes-brief-appearance (''Bangkok Post'')]
